newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1200 lbs ld 68.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Mondays Close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well established.

Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
